bilateral_symmetry_rules.enforcement: projection onto the symmetric subspace by pair average, after which the rate limit and saturation stages operate on the symmetric value
bilateral_symmetry_rules.future_release: asymmetric landing/recovery authority is explicitly NOT part of RES-85; RES-86/RES-87 must open their own authority to relax this rule
bilateral_symmetry_rules.rule: the two channels of a mirrored pair receive identical commanded moments after the symmetry projection; the per-channel constraint projection may introduce a bounded numerical asymmetry of at most 1e-9 N*m in all RES-85 phases
bilateral_symmetry_rules.telemetry: the maximum pre-projection pair asymmetry per sample is recorded; a nonzero value is reported, never hidden

channels.justification: The trunk/HAT carries the 20 kg bar through a rigid attachment; trunk-pelvis flexion torque during loaded countermovement and propulsion is bounded well below the hip channel because the bar is held rigidly and no arm swing exists. The ceiling is set above the largest trunk moment observed in deterministic Plant probes of the declared postures and is capped below the hip ceiling.
channels.notes: No V2 value is imported; V2 used a 250 N*m lumbar ceiling for a different plant.
channels.sensitivity_role: low-sensitivity posture channel; scaled in the authority sweep but not a performance driver
channels.sign_convention: positive = sagittal flexion direction of the joint coordinate

channels.evidence_class: DYNAMIC_CMJ_INVERSE_DYNAMICS (primary) + ISOKINETIC_CONTEXT_ONLY (secondary, not used as a constant)
channels.justification: Hip extension is a primary contributor to loaded-CMJ propulsion in inverse-dynamics literature; dynamic peak hip extension moments of order 2-4 N*m/kg body mass are reported for athletic countermovement tasks, giving an interval of roughly 160-320 N*m for a 79 kg athlete. The ceiling is placed at the upper edge of that dynamic interval with a sensitivity band; it is an engineering authority cap, not a physiological claim.
channels.notes: No V2 value is imported; V2 used a 250 N*m hip ceiling.
channels.sensitivity_role: primary propulsion channel; moment, power and rate ceilings all swept
channels.sign_convention: positive = hip flexion direction of the joint coordinate (axis 0 -1 0)

channels.evidence_class: DYNAMIC_CMJ_INVERSE_DYNAMICS (primary) + ISOKINETIC_CONTEXT_ONLY (secondary, not used as a constant)
channels.justification: Mirror of left_hip; identical by the frozen bilateral-symmetry rule.
channels.notes: Bilateral symmetry is enforced by the actuation layer, not assumed from the controller.
channels.sensitivity_role: primary propulsion channel; swept identically with left_hip
channels.sign_convention: positive = hip flexion direction of the joint coordinate (axis 0 -1 0)

channels.evidence_class: DYNAMIC_CMJ_INVERSE_DYNAMICS (primary) + ISOKINETIC_CONTEXT_ONLY (secondary, not used as a constant)
channels.justification: Knee extension is the strongest single contributor in CMJ inverse dynamics; peak knee extension moments of order 2-4.5 N*m/kg are reported, and knee joint power in the concentric phase reaches roughly 15-25 W/kg in trained males, giving ~1200-2000 W for 79 kg. The ceiling is placed at the upper edge of the dynamic interval with a sensitivity band.
channels.notes: No V2 value is imported; V2 used a 300 N*m knee ceiling.
channels.plant: left shank relative to left thigh
channels.sensitivity_role: primary propulsion channel; moment, power and rate ceilings all swept
channels.sign_convention: positive = knee flexion direction of the joint coordinate (axis 0 1 0)

channels.evidence_class: DYNAMIC_CMJ_INVERSE_DYNAMICS (primary) + ISOKINETIC_CONTEXT_ONLY (secondary, not used as a constant)
channels.justification: Mirror of left_knee; identical by the frozen bilateral-symmetry rule.
channels.notes: Bilateral symmetry is enforced by the actuation layer, not assumed from the controller.
channels.plant: right shank relative to right thigh
channels.sensitivity_role: primary propulsion channel; swept identically with left_knee
channels.sign_convention: positive = knee flexion direction of the joint coordinate (axis 0 1 0)

channels.evidence_class: DYNAMIC_CMJ_INVERSE_DYNAMICS (primary) + ISOKINETIC_CONTEXT_ONLY (secondary, not used as a constant)
channels.justification: Ankle plantarflexion net moments in CMJ inverse dynamics are of order 1.5-3 N*m/kg with peak ankle power roughly 10-15 W/kg in trained males. Ceiling at the upper edge of the dynamic interval; the MTP channel is separately bounded so the ankle ceiling is not circumvented through the toe.
channels.notes: No V2 value is imported; V2 used a 200 N*m ankle ceiling.
channels.plant: left hindfoot relative to left shank
channels.sensitivity_role: primary takeoff channel; moment, power and rate ceilings all swept
channels.sign_convention: negative = plantarflexion direction of the joint coordinate; positive = dorsiflexion (axis 0 -1 0)

channels.evidence_class: DYNAMIC_CMJ_INVERSE_DYNAMICS (primary) + ISOKINETIC_CONTEXT_ONLY (secondary, not used as a constant)
channels.justification: Mirror of left_ankle; identical by the frozen bilateral-symmetry rule.
channels.notes: Bilateral symmetry is enforced by the actuation layer, not assumed from the controller.
channels.plant: right hindfoot relative to right shank
channels.sensitivity_role: primary takeoff channel; swept identically with left_ankle
channels.sign_convention: negative = plantarflexion direction of the joint coordinate; positive = dorsiflexion (axis 0 -1 0)

channels.justification: Measured external MTP moments during push-off are of order 6-14 N*m, and calculated maximal intrinsic toe-flexor moments are 4-7 N*m at the first MTP. The active channel ceiling is set at approximately three times the measured external dynamic moment, far below the value that would let the toe become a primary takeoff energy source. The passive FM-09 prior (k = 25 N*m/rad) is NOT part of this ceiling.
channels.notes: Active MTP energetics are additionally governed by MTP_ENERGY_AUTHORITY.json, which is the controlling anti-energy-injection rule.
channels.plant: left toe relative to left forefoot
channels.sensitivity_role: bounded auxiliary channel; must never dominate takeoff energetics; swept including the zero-active case
channels.sign_convention: positive = MTP dorsiflexion direction of the joint coordinate (axis 0 -1 0)

channels.justification: Mirror of left_mtp; identical by the frozen bilateral-symmetry rule.
channels.notes: Bilateral symmetry is enforced by the actuation layer, not assumed from the controller.
channels.plant: right toe relative to right forefoot
channels.sensitivity_role: bounded auxiliary channel; swept identically with left_mtp
channels.sign_convention: positive = MTP dorsiflexion direction of the joint coordinate (axis 0 -1 0)

ctrl_semantics.applies_to: the nine motor actuators of the sealed V3 Plant only
ctrl_semantics.channel_meaning: ctrl[i] is the physical net joint moment in N*m applied about joint i (gear = 1)
ctrl_semantics.no_external_force: no qfrc_applied / xfrc_applied / state override is permitted
ctrl_semantics.no_plant_mutation: the authority is enforced in the control layer; the Plant XML, solver, contact parameters and passive MTP prior are never modified

enforcement_order: 1_command_reception: receive the controller's desired net moment per channel
2_bilateral_symmetry_projection: for each mirrored pair (hip, knee, ankle, mtp) replace both by (left+right)/2 and record the pre-projection asymmetry magnitude

3_hard_safety_bound_construction: per channel construct the HARD_SAFETY_BOUNDS interval [-cap_hard, cap_hard] with cap_hard = min(moment_ceiling, power_ceiling/|qdot|, MTP_energy_gate_cap); hard safety bounds are never exceeded
4_nominal_slew_bound_construction: per channel construct the NOMINAL_SLEW_BOUND interval [prev - rate_ceiling*dt, prev + rate_ceiling*dt]; prev is the previous applied torque, the sole history state
5_interval_projection: applied = clip(symmetric_command, lo, hi) with [lo, hi] the intersection of the hard-safety and nominal-slew intervals; the sample is nominal-slew compliant

6_safety_override: if a changing hard safety bound makes the intersection empty (lo > hi) the hard safety bound wins; the instantaneous reduction is recorded as an explicit safety override carrying the single binding hard constraint (moment_ceiling | joint_power_ceiling | mtp_energy_gate | mtp_phase_gate) and the violated nominal slew margin; an override sample is never reported as nominal-slew compliant
7_apply: write the nine applied moments to data.ctrl
8_record: per-sample per-channel applied moment, torque rate, saturation stage, safety-override flag/reason, nominal slew exceedance, margin to each hard limit, and joint power

external_evidence.use: dynamic hip/ankle net torques and ankle power in two-legged versus one-legged countermovement jumps
CMJ peak lower-limb joint torque and power determinants; concentric knee extension rate of torque development
elite male CMJ peak hip torque/power and knee angular velocity correlation
joint-level power load profiles in CMJ
measured external MTP moments 6.3-14.2 N*m in the push-off
calculated maximal MTP flexion moments 4.27-6.84 N*m (1st MTP)
MTP joint mechanical role in the take-off phase of human jumping
voluntary knee extension peak rate of torque development context only

feasible_interval_note: the enforcement chain is a projection onto the intersection of the hard-safety interval (moment/power/MTP energy) and the nominal-slew interval around the previous applied moment. A hard safety bound always wins: when it shrinks faster than the nominal slew can follow, the empty intersection is recorded as an explicit SAFETY_OVERRIDE naming the single binding hard constraint and the violated nominal slew margin. Hard moment, hard power and hard MTP energy limits are never exceeded; nominal slew exceedance is exactly zero on every sample that is not a declared safety override.

forbidden_imports.r001_values: no R001-derived controller, load or timing value is imported
forbidden_imports.v2_torque_limits: V2_TORQUE_LIMITS_NM (lumbar 250 / hip 250 / knee 300 / ankle 200) is explicitly NOT imported

hard_safety_bounds_semantics.attribution: every safety override is attributable to exactly one binding hard constraint
hard_safety_bounds_semantics.moment_ceiling_abs: the hard net-moment ceiling is enforced on the applied moment every sample
hard_safety_bounds_semantics.mtp_energy_gate: the MTP active/total positive-work gates are enforced as hard caps and set the MTP cap to exactly zero when exhausted or phase-denied
hard_safety_bounds_semantics.power_ceiling_abs: the hard |tau*qdot| joint-power ceiling is enforced every sample where |qdot| > qdot_epsilon
hard_safety_bounds_semantics.precedence: a hard safety bound always wins over the nominal slew bound

joint_power_semantics.below_epsilon: no power saturation is applied below qdot_epsilon because the power product is numerically meaningless there; the moment ceiling still applies
joint_power_semantics.definition: p_j = applied_moment_j * qdot_joint_j (signed instantaneous mechanical power at the joint)
joint_power_semantics.enforcement: HARD_CEILING_ON_ABS_POWER when the joint angular velocity is materially non-zero
joint_power_semantics.rationale: prevents unbounded instantaneous mechanical power at any channel while leaving the necessarily discontinuous sign region unfiltered

saturation_semantics.margin_convention: margin = limit - |value| at the exit of that stage; negative margin is impossible by construction and a non-negative margin is recorded
saturation_semantics.never_reverses_sign: rate, moment and power stages never change the sign of the commanded moment
saturation_semantics.no_silent_clamping: every stage that changes a value must be recorded in telemetry with the stage name and the pre-clamp value

torque_rate_semantics.activation_smoothing_secondary: none: no filter, no activation state, no low-pass; the nominal slew bound is the only smoothing and it is enforced as a nominal inequality, not a filter
torque_rate_semantics.first_sample_rule: at reset the previous applied torque is exactly zero; the first command is therefore slew-limited from zero
torque_rate_semantics.override_rule: a nominal slew exceedance exists only on a sample carrying an explicit safety override; the override reason names exactly one binding hard constraint and the violated nominal slew margin is recorded per channel as the positive slew exceedance magnitude
torque_rate_semantics.phase_handoff_continuity: the previous-applied-torque history is owned solely by the actuation layer and persists across all controller phase handoffs; no phase may reset or bypass it; a handoff itself never creates a slew exceedance because the interval is built around the persisted previous applied torque

unilateral_independence.note: the Plant may load one foot more than the other; the authority enforces symmetric *commands*, not symmetric *force*
